WAREHOUSE.TITLE: Help — Warehouse
WAREHOUSE.SEARCH_DESC: Filter the inventory by name, category or code in real time as you type.
WAREHOUSE.DETAIL_DESC: Click any row to view the full product sheet and link it to the AEMPS database.
WAREHOUSE.INSERT_DESC: Add a product manually to the inventory by filling in the form.
WAREHOUSE.AEMPS_DESC: Import medicines directly from the official Ministry of Health catalogue.
WAREHOUSE.PDF_DESC: Download the full inventory as a PDF with the pharmacy logo.
WAREHOUSE.EDIT_DESC: Edit the price and quantity of an existing product.
WAREHOUSE.DELETE_DESC: Delete a product from the inventory. This action is irreversible.

SALES_HISTORY.TITLE: Help — Sales History
SALES_HISTORY.HISTORY_DESC: Shows all sales recorded in the system with their details.
SALES_HISTORY.SEARCH_DESC: Filter the history by seller or client name.
SALES_HISTORY.DATE_DESC: Filter sales by day using the date picker.
SALES_HISTORY.BULK_DESC: Select multiple sales with the checkboxes and click "Cancel Selected" to cancel them in bulk.
SALES_HISTORY.CANCELLED_DESC: Cancelled sales are moved to that section and the KPIs update automatically.
SALES_HISTORY.EXCEL_DESC: Download the filtered history as a .xlsx file.

SALES_PANEL.TITLE: Help — Sales Panel
SALES_PANEL.SEARCH_DESC: Search for a product by name or category.
SALES_PANEL.ADD_DESC: Click to add it to the cart. Out-of-stock products appear disabled.
SALES_PANEL.MULTIPLE_DESC: Repeat the process to add more products to the same sale.
SALES_PANEL.CART_DESC: Once you have all the products, go to the cart to finalise the sale.
SALES_PANEL.NOTE: Only users with Admin or Seller role can process sales

CART.TITLE: Help — Cart
CART.REVIEW_DESC: Review the products and quantities before confirming payment.
CART.QUANTITY_DESC: Use the + and − buttons to increase or decrease the units of each product.
CART.EMPTY_DESC: Remove all products from the cart and start a new sale from scratch.
CART.COMPLETE_DESC: Click "Complete Shop" to advance to the payment step and confirm the transaction.
CART.DNI_DESC: Enter the client's DNI or NIE and click Pay to confirm. The PDF ticket is generated and the stock updated.
CART.NOTE: Completing the payment generates a PDF ticket and updates the stock
